run1_failures_and_fixes: tests/batch/runtime/test_runtime_checkpoint.py::test_crash_resume_completes_and_reuses_committed_rows — runtime defect: mp.Queue.put is feeder-buffered, so a worker completing row 0 and immediately os._exit-ing on row 1's injected startup fault truncated the completed sibling result in the feeder buffer; drain-then-raise can only extend across RECEIVABLE results, so the crash prefix came back empty. Fixed: outbox is now _ResultChannel over ctx.SimpleQueue (put pickles and writes synchronously under a POSIX lock; get(timeout) via reader poll; close/join_thread keep _Pool.cancel's teardown surface). Regression: test_result_channel_put_is_synchronous_across_abrupt_death (fork probe, put -> immediate os._exit -> parent still receives).
